You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many more girl scout badges does Wendy earn than Amber in one year? Claire earns 1 girl scout badge every month. Amber takes twice as long as Claire to earn a girl scout badge. Wendy earns three times as many girl scout badges as Claire in the same time frame. The time frame is 1 year. Wendy's six-month badge-earning period is uninterrupted. Wendy's Girl Scout troop charges a $25 annual membership fee per scout. Wendy is enrolled for the full 12-month membership year. Wendy's badge-earning rate is constant throughout the year.
